purpose: Empirical test of read_file on the single largest and longest video across all 82 fetchable benchmark videos (8pOOxOo7YYo) without recompression, to verify whether a 15MB re-encode rule is needed.
conclusion: read_file ingested the largest & longest video in the entire 82-video benchmark (40.14 MiB / 755.8s) natively with zero error and full video+audio from 0:00 to 12:35 (~79.7k input tokens). Therefore, the pre-emptive 15MB recompression rule is REMOVED: all 82 benchmark videos will be passed at their original downloaded quality without recompression. Compression/splitting is reserved strictly as an exception ONLY if an unexpected runtime read_file size/token limit error occurs.
